title: A Module Manager save writes only the preference keys it changes

source.ref: The residual LIVE-2347 named (manage/modules/actions.ts, a whole-blob spaces.preferences writer)

detail: The Module Manager (manage/modules/actions.ts: saveSpaceModuleMenu, the menu order, hidden and activated lists, and chooseSpaceNiche, the starting-setup niche on megaTheme) built the whole spaces.preferences object from a snapshot read at the start of the request and wrote it all back with .update({ preferences }). A menu or niche save landing beside a save from another console (a Spotlight publish, a Page panel change) could undo it. Fixed as LIVE-2347 did for the Page panel: a writePreferences helper diffs the mutator's result against the snapshot (lib/spaces/preferences-patch.ts preferencesPatch) and sends only the changed top-level keys through patchSpacePreferences (set_space_preferences, SCAN-833). A menu save patches moduleMenu alone (null when every list is empty, which clears the node as before); a niche save patches megaTheme alone; an unchanged save is a no-op success. The entitlements and feature_roles writes in the same file are separate columns and unchanged. No migration. Residual: the RPC merges top-level keys only, so two saves to the same key from different tabs can still overwrite each other inside that key.

verify.note: Fails while manage/modules/actions.ts replaces the whole preferences blob, or saveSpaceModuleMenu / chooseSpaceNiche do not save through a writePreferences that sends a key-scoped patch. Behavior test: app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/modules/actions.test.ts.
